summary: PDS Biotechnology filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on September 22, 2026, disclosing a press release announcing publication of Phase 2 VERSATILE-002 trial results for PDS0101 plus pembrolizumab in HPV16-positive recurrent/metastatic head and neck cancer in the September 17, 2026 issue of JAMA Oncology. Reported median overall survival was 39.3 months in immune checkpoint inhibitor-naive patients versus 17.9 months for standard of care. No deal, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situations mechanics are present; the registrant is the filer. Risk-arb angle: none; watch partnership strategy for PDS0101 and prioritization of PDS0301 in metastatic colorectal cancer.
